adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the new permission flag is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))` and stored in a variable named `isTeamAdminOrOwner`. This requires the user to be both an admin and an owner to pass the team permission path. The subsequent check `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN` means a user who is only a team admin (or only a team owner) will be denied unless they are also the organizer or an attendee, which contradicts the intended “admin OR owner” access suggested by the variable name.
